pinned_behavior: typical: two servers; updates the one with ip '10.0.0.1' (port, username, password, keyid) and leaves the other unchanged; prints 'Server updated.'.
edge: an unregistered ip changes nothing, but the message is printed anyway.
invalid: a password given as a dictionary raises sqlite3.ProgrammingError; nothing printed and the table stays the same.
not_pinned_on_purpose: Connection left open when the UPDATE fails: accidental side effect, not observable by the caller.
notes: The new ip is also used in the WHERE, so the function cannot change the ip of a server; pinned as it is.
